texts.content:
Extremely rare, this species dwells in the abyssal depths, where it glows with fluctuating
intensity against the mineral darkness.  Its bioluminescence mimics the glow of electric species,
making it appear more toxic and less attractive to opportunistic predators.

It feeds on specific mineral-rich rocks from the seafloor, which it processes internally and
regurgitates as a dense, dark, viscous mist-similar to metallic plasma. This substance slowly descends into 0
deeper zones, where it accumulates and nourishes marine vegetation, subtly reshaping entire ecosystems.

Equipped with three eyes and an ill-defined physiology, these creatures are rarely
easy prey: they live in large groups,can propel themselves at high speed, and
when threatened, expel their metal-laced  mist as a biological
cannon-capable of disorienting, damaging, or repelling any intruder.
